tests.name: Non-Kindle menus have no stock option; device category has no separate stock page
Kindle option is scoped to Wallpaper and refresh does not duplicate or mutate native providers
Native menu selection enables random stock images and preserves all display preferences
Choosing custom random images restores prior folder and clears stock selection
Choosing cover exits stock mode; a second activation restores latest custom preferences
Missing image directory reports failure without changing wallpaper or closing its page
Legacy independent screen settings migrate without retaining hidden display overrides
Global settings search finds the same nested Wallpaper choice without independent route
Reader gets the same Wallpaper option and switching away preserves display settings
